direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px Header / 52px GuideStrip / minmax(0,1fr) / 56px DecisionBar; cols 184px StepRail / minmax(0,1fr) FactoryStage / 360px EvidenceInspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw and 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; targets at least 36px; refit tight panels before shrinking type
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A on #050705, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text as the owner-required exception; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; tabular quantities, time and cost; enlarge stage labels under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; visible 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries second and final logo placement; StepRail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; GuideStrip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and DecisionBar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Enlarge the second logo placement in the opening story banner and give it a quiet silver keyline so the required placement reads as a deliberate hero moment, not a thumbnail.
Refit the evidence list so the second source card is fully visible at 1366x768 without relying on the thin scrollbar; compress the hero metrics row by 8px.
Raise RECEIVING and CELL labels to 11px minimum and add a focus ring to each focusable SVG node with bidirectional inspector highlighting.

Keep ROUTE HEALTH - PRE-FLIGHT and INVESTIGATION - SOURCE EVIDENCE as separate headed regions with independent status lines; label the first nonce/identity health only and the second as the evidence task.
Add aria-describedby to the route select explaining offline-no-request versus live route, and keep Run Sample investigation as the sole primary in the DecisionBar.
Enlarge the small ev-cert-qty and ev-recv-qty stage labels to 11px and strengthen the dashed connector contrast against the grid.
When an option is selected, confirm the typed consent form opens directly beneath it with the exact phrase, typed count and disabled Accept state grouped as one labelled form region.
Add a visible 2px neon focus ring to each Select this path control and announce selection changes via aria-live polite.
Refit the inspector so the consent input and helper text never push the third option off-screen; allow internal scroll only inside the options list.
Make the 3 proposed - UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL banner larger and keep Decline proposal reachable without scrolling past all task cards.
Fix the overlapping RECOVERY FLOW and MAT-ALLOY-B route labels on the stage; offset them vertically so neither is clipped by the neon trace.
Add status markers plus text to each proposed task card so untracked state is not carried by dashed border alone.
Strengthen the preview state for CELL-MILL-2 with a PREVIEW - WILL GO OFFLINE label, dashed silver outline and text warning before Apply, reserving red for the actual stopped state after application.
Move the invalidation warning into the DecisionBar centre status so it is visible beside Apply second shock without scanning the inspector.
Dim the Scenario management admin row and give it a disabled focus treatment until it becomes actionable.
Preserve red exclusively on stopped CELL-MILL-2; remove the red STOPPED ghost text overlapping the 80 track and place one OFFLINE-STOPPED label under the cell.
Separate pre-flight route health from the investigation task with the same distinct headings as step 2, and retitle the primary Reinvestigate recovery to match the evidence task.
Mark Split available capacity as constrained on the stage with pattern plus text, matching the inspector state.
Keep the constrained Split option visibly hatched with its reason text and non-selectable state; ensure keyboard focus skips it while screen readers announce why.
Surface PRIOR ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED in the GuideStrip as well as the DecisionBar so the need for fresh typed consent is seen before scrolling the form.
Enlarge the STOPPED label above CELL-MILL-2 to 11px and align it so it does not collide with the 120 track.

Keep Prior tracked work - 3 BLOCKED and 3 proposed - UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL as two clearly separated groups; the approved revised plan status belongs in the DecisionBar, not merged into either group.
Refit the project board so Approve revised tasks and Decline proposal are both visible at 1366x768 without the task list pushing Decline below the fold.
Add Blocked text badges to prior tasks t1-t3 in addition to strikethrough so state survives reduced motion and grayscale.
Sequence the three proof actions as a numbered vertical stepper with Verify ledger as the sole primary until complete, then move primary emphasis to Seal and Export in turn.
Show passphrase requirements as a live checklist beside the input and keep its focus ring clear of the fieldset legend overlap.
Compress the stage event chain labels so 18 EVENTS and job due labels fit without crowding at stage width.
Add a clear completion primary or Lock recovery room emphasis in the DecisionBar beside the sealed status, since Back alone undersells the final action.
Mark all three retained-evidence steps Complete with check plus text and disable their buttons with explained state, retaining pointer style only on enabled controls.
Give the Recovery story complete rail item aria-current and a check plus text treatment consistent with the sealed packet banner.
